footprint.symmetry: mostly symmetrical on front/back axis; chimney breaks bilateral symmetry on one side

raw_elements: rows of horizontal windows on each floor (repeating pattern)
central recessed entrance with small stone slab porch
stepped dark gable roof with overhang
offset square chimney/tower rising above roof on one side
light accents (glowstone) at lower floor corners
raw_hints: Build a rectangular base roughly 13x11 blocks. Raise three uniform floors of stonebrick, each floor about 3 blocks tall, separated by a 1-block-high lighter stone slab trim.
Place continuous 3-4 block long horizontal windows (glass) on each floor aligned across the facade; put glowstone accents near the lower floor outer window sections.

Create a stepped dark brick gable roof centered on the footprint with a 1-block overhang; add an offset 3x3 square chimney/tower of stonebrick reaching one story above the roof and capped with the same dark roof material.
Add a small recessed central entrance with a 2-block-wide stone slab porch and a darker 1-block-deep doorway recess.
rebuild_intent.summary: Three-storey rectangular residential-style building with a dark steep stepped gable roof and a short square chimney/tower offset to one side. Each floor is a consistent band of stone-like walls with long horizontal windows and a thin lighter horizontal trim between floors. Building sits centered on a cleared rectangular dirt plot with a low stone foundation.
